components.intent: Organize the clinic as a rooted courtyard cluster that distributes public, clinical, and service functions around a protected central open space.
Create an approach-facing reception and waiting pavilion forming the south edge of the courtyard cluster.
Place consultation rooms in a perpendicular clinical wing directly accessible from reception.
Place treatment along the quiet north edge with direct adjacency to the consultation wing.
Concentrate staff and service support in a detached east wing separated from public waiting by the courtyard void.

constraint_responses.rationale: The 1216-square-metre schematic footprint lies within the declared range, while net-area allocation remains a risk because no room schedule or bounded departmental net-area targets were supplied.

proposal.label: Courtyard clinic cluster
proposal.rationale: Nineteen 64-square-metre cells produce a 1216-square-metre footprint within the declared 1200–1600-square-metre range. Unlike the excluded linear sequence, this alternative uses a clustered courtyard topology: reception addresses the primary approach, consultation turns perpendicular from arrival, treatment closes the quiet north edge, and support occupies a detached east wing across the courtyard void.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A single-level courtyard clinic in which reception, consultation, and treatment form an L-shaped connected clinical route while a detached support wing defines the opposite courtyard edge and remains separated from public waiting.

components.intent: Organize the clinic as one rooted schematic assembly with a legible public-to-clinical sequence and a detached service-support mass.
Form the arrival-facing reception and waiting mass nearest the declared primary approach.
Provide the intermediate consultation mass directly connected to reception and treatment.
Provide a treatment mass adjacent to consultation at the quieter end of the clinical sequence.
Hold staff and service support in a separated mass offset from the public waiting area.

constraint_responses.rationale: The schematic footprint is fixed at the declared minimum gross footprint of 1200 square metres, but net-area allocation remains unresolved because no room schedule or net-area targets were supplied.

existing_option_projection.label: Compact linear clinic sequence
existing_option_projection.rationale: Twelve 100-square-metre grid cells establish a 1200-square-metre schematic footprint at the lower bound of the declared range. Reception aligns with the declared primary approach, consultation bridges reception and treatment, and the support mass is offset to express the required separation from waiting.
existing_option_projection.typology_hypothesis: A single-level compact clinic organized as a short linear public and clinical sequence, with staff and service support held in a nearby but spatially separated bar.

alternative_context.instructions: Author a complete independent alternative with a new option_id and meaningfully different spatial topology. Do not rename, patch, or select the existing option.

payload.instructions: Author one schematic option from only the supplied current records. Create the existing DesignComponent tree and its coarse massing volumes in the same proposal. Every volume must have exactly one component owner. Preserve project evidence references and return only the required output object; do not select, persist, execute, or claim validation.

component_geometry_invariants: components form exactly one rooted acyclic tree
every volume id exists and is owned by exactly one component
component and volume source refs are present in evidence_refs
proposal authority fields equal proposal_fixed_values exactly

item_exact_fields.unresolved_child_roles: array of local-id strings; empty allowed
item_exact_fields.volume_ids: array of local-id strings; empty allowed

exact_fields.maximum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]
exact_fields.minimum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]

assumptions.statement: The numeric ranges are direct user-declared experiment inputs, preserved as bounded values rather than point defaults.

obligations.statement: Derive bounded net-area hypotheses or preserve net area as unknown.

scenarios.label: Whole-building declared capacity and area envelope

reference_contract.nested_source_rule: every nested source_ref must also appear in proposal.evidence_refs

required_invariants: program_scenario_ref names a current program scenario
footprint_range_ref names a compatible current footprint range
footprint area equals len(footprint_cells) multiplied by grid_basis.horizontal_area_per_cell
footprint area is within the cited footprint range and uses the same area_unit
every footprint cell x/z lies inside the observed site envelope
every level spans inclusive y from base_y through base_y + height - 1 inside the site envelope
every volume bound lies inside the site envelope and names only current level_ids
for each volume include every inclusive [x,z] pair from bounds.minimum through bounds.maximum in footprint_cells
each volume projection contains at most 4096 inclusive x/z cells
each named level is vertically contained by its volume bounds
every current function_ref appears in exactly one zone and no other program_node_ref is used
every zone names only declared level_ids and volume_ids
each connection joins zones containing its relationship source and target nodes and matches relationship directed exactly
every required response ref is covered by a constraint_response or a matching connection relationship_ref
